claim: ELIZA makes it easy to create and maintain the illusion of understanding
limit: Close reading of one article; this project has no user study

claim: The test of understanding is drawing valid conclusions, not continuing a conversation
limit: A program-level claim, not a benchmark of current LLMs

claim: Capture tracks activity through a grammar and reorganizes that activity
limit: Conceptual model; no empirical test of this UI

claim: LLMs manipulate linguistic form rather than perform natural language understanding
limit: Argued for large LMs generally; this prototype is not evaluated

claim: A 3D body, voice, and gaze are designed to produce a sense of presence
limit: Design intention; no user study of presence

claim: The perception ledger shows the model's input and can be paused
limit: Transparency claim untested; pause only stops new observations

claim: The avatar keeps a short local speech and memory context
limit: Prototype behaviour, not a model of long-term memory

claim: The deployed build splits a 71MB VRM into four hash-named parts
limit: Build artifact; model licensing is separate

claim: Gemini Live accepts 16kHz PCM audio and JPEG frames up to 1fps
limit: Preview service; region and model availability vary

claim: Autonomous gestures are inferred from the reply when the model returns none
limit: Heuristic; it can gesture at the wrong moment

claim: The avatar is likely to invite anthropomorphic trust by combining voice, gaze, and memory
evidence: Weizenbaum (1966); Bender et al. (2021); prototype UI
limit: Inference from literature and design, not measured with users
